# konnect_gateway_workspace (Resource)

GatewayWorkspace Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_gateway_workspace" "my_gatewayworkspace" {
  comment          = "A test workspace for team 1"
  control_plane_id = "cb4ca5b5-c0ad-4659-ac3b-9b4f1a9cb687"
  description      = "A test workspace for team 1"
  managed_by = {
    key = "value"
  }
  name = "team-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_plane_id` (String) ID of a control plane
- `name` (String) The name of the workspace.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The description of the workspace.
- `description` (String) The description of the workspace.
- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric character.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The unique UUID for this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_gateway_workspace.my_konnect_gateway_workspace
  id = jsonencode({
    control_plane_id = "..."
    id               = "2747d1e5-8246-4f65-a939-b392f1ee17f8"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_gateway_workspace.my_konnect_gateway_workspace '{"control_plane_id": "...", "id": "2747d1e5-8246-4f65-a939-b392f1ee17f8"}'
```
